<!--
This should be loaded into a notebook with quarto shortcodes:
`{{< include /components/_adminSelectorsMulti.qmd >}}`

This esentially copies this code into that notebook during render,
so any variables defined here can be used in the notebook/will also
conflict with other global variables in the notebook. -->

<!--IMPORTANT:
This requires the enhancedMultiSelect component to be imported
from helpers/enhancedMultiSelect.ojs

This also relies on _lang being defined, so the _lang component must also
be loaded into the notebook with:
`{{< include /components/_lang.qmd >}}`
-->

<!-- NOTE:
Due to how OJS updates cells, when inputs are duplicated across sections they need
to be defined again with different names and placed in a div. This is because the inputs
trigger a re-render of the cell every time they are selected, so the focus on the input is
lost. To see what happens use the following wrong example:
html`<div style="display: flex; gap: 2em;">${renderA0Multi()} ${renderA1Multi()} ${renderA2Multi()}</div>`;

Correct Example usage:
/// THese don't need viewof as they are already bound to a global input
section1A0 = renderA0Multi();
section1A1 = renderA1Multi();
section1A2 = renderA2Multi();
html`<div style="display: flex; gap: 2em;">${section1A0} ${section1A1} ${section1A2}</div>`;
-->

```{ojs}
adminDB = await DuckDBClient.of({
  admin_lookup: await FileAttachment(
    "/data/shared/gaul24_africa_lookup.parquet",
  ),
});
```

```{ojs}
// ADMIN 0
countries = {
  const country_list = await FileAttachment("/data/shared/atlas_countries.json").json();
  const filteredCountries = country_list
    .filter((c) => c.include && c.iso3c !== "SDN")
    .map(({ include, ...rest }) => rest);
  return filteredCountries;
};

viewof admin0Select = Inputs.input(Object.values(countries).slice(0, 1))

renderA0Multi = ({maxSelections = Infinity, requireAtLeastOne = false} = {}) => {
    const _admin0 = Inputs.select(countries, {
        //NOTE: _lang & general_translations are defined in 
        // components/_lang.qmd
        //Both must be loaded into a notebook for this to work.
        label: _lang(general_translations.country),
        format: (d) => _lang(d.translation),
        // format: (d) => d.iso3c,
        multiple: true
      }
    );
    // Adds the additional features to the multi-select
    enhancedMultiSelect(_admin0, { maxSelections, requireAtLeastOne })
    // Bind to the main global multi-select for updates across NB
    return Inputs.bind(_admin0, viewof admin0Select)
}
```

```{ojs}
// Admin1

//NOTE: less hacky than below. Read in all admin 1 and filter
allAdmin1 = {
 const resp = await adminDB.query(`
    SELECT DISTINCT admin0_name, admin1_name, iso3
    FROM admin_lookup
    WHERE iso3 in ('${countries.map((d) => d.iso3c).join("', '")}')
  `);

  return resp;
}

dataAdmin1 = allAdmin1.filter(d =>
  admin0Select.some(a0 => a0.iso3c === d.iso3)
);

viewof admin1Select = Inputs.input([])

// CR-106 (2026-06-11): popup multi-select ported from the sandbox
// (CR-097 pattern) — replaces the enhancedMultiSelect dropdown for
// admin1. Adds a search box + Select all / Clear, a count-style
// button, and a scrollable checkbox list. Better UX for countries with
// 20+ admin1s. Contract preserved: the bound `admin1Select` is still an
// array of `dataAdmin1` OBJECTS ({admin0_name, admin1_name, iso3}), so
// downstream `.map(d => d.admin1_name)` / `.iso3` consumers are unchanged.
//
// Reactivity: the popup manages its own internal `selected` state and
// writes OUT to `viewof admin1Select` via setSelectorValue — it never
// reads the reactive `admin1Select` value, so toggling a checkbox does
// NOT re-render this cell (avoids the focus-loss the component NOTE
// warns about). Changing the country re-runs dataAdmin1 → this cell
// re-renders with a fresh empty popup (clears stale admin1s).
renderA1Multi = ({maxSelections = Infinity, requireAtLeastOne = false} = {}) => {
    const opts = dataAdmin1;
    const labelOf = (d) => `${d.admin1_name || "Full Country"} (${d.iso3})`;
    const sameOpt = (a, b) => a.admin1_name === b.admin1_name && a.iso3 === b.iso3;
    let selected = [];

    const wrap = html`<form class="a1-popup-multi" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.2rem;min-width:240px;position:relative;font-family:inherit;">
      <label style="font:700 9pt sans-serif;letter-spacing:0.5px;color:#1d1d1d;">${_lang(general_translations.region)}</label>
    </form>`;
    const btn = html`<button type="button" style="width:100%;text-align:left;padding:0.375rem 0.75rem;border:1px solid #ced4da;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;border-radius:0.25rem;font:14px/1.5 sans-serif;color:#212529;min-height:38px;">All regions ▼</button>`;
    const dropdown = html`<div style="display:none;position:absolute;z-index:9999;top:calc(100% + 2px);left:0;min-width:280px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.18);padding:8px;">`;
    const search = html`<input type="text" placeholder="Search…" style="width:100%;padding:4px 8px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:3px;box-sizing:border-box;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:0.86em;">`;
    const actRow = html`<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px;">`;
    const selAll = html`<button type="button" style="font-size:0.8em;padding:2px 8px;cursor:pointer;">Select all</button>`;
    const clrBtn = html`<button type="button" style="font-size:0.8em;padding:2px 8px;cursor:pointer;">Clear</button>`;
    const closeBtn = html`<button type="button" style="font-size:0.8em;padding:2px 8px;cursor:pointer;margin-left:auto;">Close ✕</button>`;
    const hint = html`<div style="font-size:0.74em;color:#888;margin-bottom:4px;min-height:1em;"></div>`;
    const listDiv = html`<div style="max-height:240px;overflow-y:auto;">`;

    const atLimit = () => Number.isFinite(maxSelections) && selected.length >= maxSelections;
    const isSel = (d) => selected.some((s) => sameOpt(s, d));

    const commit = () => {
      btn.textContent = selected.length === 0
        ? "All regions ▼"
        : `${selected.length}${Number.isFinite(maxSelections) ? " / " + maxSelections : ""} selected ▼`;
      hint.textContent = atLimit() ? `Maximum ${maxSelections} selected — clear one to choose another.` : "";
      setSelectorValue(viewof admin1Select, selected);
    };

    const renderList = (q = "") => {
      listDiv.innerHTML = "";
      const ql = q.toLowerCase();
      opts.filter((d) => labelOf(d).toLowerCase().includes(ql)).forEach((d) => {
        const checked = isSel(d);
        const disabled = !checked && atLimit();
        const lbl = html`<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:3px 4px;cursor:${disabled ? "not-allowed" : "pointer"};font-size:0.86em;color:${disabled ? "#aaa" : "#212529"};">`;
        const cb = html`<input type="checkbox">`;
        cb.checked = checked;
        cb.disabled = disabled;
        cb.onchange = () => {
          selected = cb.checked ? [...selected, d] : selected.filter((s) => !sameOpt(s, d));
          renderList(search.value);
          commit();
        };
        lbl.append(cb, document.createTextNode(labelOf(d)));
        listDiv.append(lbl);
      });
    };

    btn.onclick = () => {
      if (dropdown.style.display === "none") {
        dropdown.style.display = "block"; search.value = ""; renderList(); search.focus();
      } else { dropdown.style.display = "none"; }
    };
    closeBtn.onclick = () => { dropdown.style.display = "none"; };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
      if (dropdown.style.display === "none") return;
      if (wrap.contains(e.target)) return;
      dropdown.style.display = "none";
    });
    search.oninput = () => renderList(search.value);
    selAll.onclick = () => {
      selected = Number.isFinite(maxSelections) ? opts.slice(0, maxSelections) : [...opts];
      renderList(search.value); commit();
    };
    clrBtn.onclick = () => { selected = []; renderList(search.value); commit(); };

    actRow.append(selAll, clrBtn, closeBtn);
    dropdown.append(search, actRow, hint, listDiv);
    wrap.append(btn, dropdown);
    renderList();
    commit();
    return wrap;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Admin2
dataAdmin2 = await adminDB.query(`
  SELECT DISTINCT admin0_name, admin1_name, admin2_name, iso3
  FROM admin_lookup
  WHERE iso3 in ('${admin0Select.map((d) => d.iso3c).join("', '")}')
  AND admin1_name in ('${admin1Select.map((d) => d.admin1_name).join("', '")}')
`)

viewof admin2Select = Inputs.input([])

renderA2Multi = ({maxSelections = Infinity, requireAtLeastOne = false} = {}) => {
    const _admin2 = Inputs.select(
      dataAdmin2,
      {
        label: _lang(general_translations.district),
        format: (d) => `${d.admin2_name} (${d.iso3})`,
        multiple: true
      }
    )
    enhancedMultiSelect(_admin2, { maxSelections, requireAtLeastOne })
    return Inputs.bind(_admin2, viewof admin2Select)
}
```

```{ojs}
//HACK: inputs hang if admin0 is diselected with chosen admin1
// and so on... this resets it
function setSelectorValue(input, value) {
  input.value = value;
  input.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
}

{
  // If nothing selected in admin1, nothing to validate
  if (!admin1Select.length) return;

  // Set of iso3 codes from selected admin1 (a1)
  const selectedA1Iso3 = new Set(admin1Select.map(d => d.iso3));

  // If all iso3 codes in a0 are not in selectedA1Iso3
  const a1NoMatch = admin0Select.every(obj => !selectedA1Iso3.has(obj.iso3c));

  if (a1NoMatch) {
    // Clear admin1 selection since it conflicts with the selected admin0
    setSelectorValue(viewof admin1Select, []);
    return;
  }

  //TODO: This probably needs expanded to admin2 as well
}
```
